blind.description: A small hand shovel or entrenching tool lying flat on the ground. It features a rectangular dark-metal scoop blade with rolled edges, connected via a black metal socket to a straight cylindrical wooden shaft that terminates in a wooden T-grip handle. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with no broken polygons, holes, or floating elements.
blind.from_above: Seen horizontally: a vertical T-handle on the left connected to a brown cylindrical rod, leading to a dark metallic square-shaped shovel blade on the right.
blind.height_vs_figure: Extremely short compared to the 5 ft 9 in figure as it lies flat on the ground (under 4 inches tall); its total length is roughly 2 feet (about one-third the height of the figure).
